speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She should have minded her mother.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am here, Mistress. I am not hurrying you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the mother should have minded her. And the friar is a meddler, and the nurse wants whipping, and the old men are fools, and I'd not have had the prince's office for a pension.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take the time the night took. I have not asked you for the end.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The torches smoked. I had something in mine eye at the end. That is all I shall say of the end.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Were the two houses friends after, Mistress? I ask it carefully. I was at the loom.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: For the length of a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the length they were given. I am not lengthening it at breakfast.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is it true they're boys? All of them? Even the one that dies?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Even she. He's fifteen, and lodges in Aldermanbury, and ate two pies after.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Two pies. That is the most wonderful part of all.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I held it since four o'clock. I did not ask it in the street, and I did not ask it in the gallery. I asked it at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have the answer. The pies are not a reason to go again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not selling you a second afternoon. I did not sell you the first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I shall not go again. Once is knowledge. Twice is appetite.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The loom heard none of it. If the house is quiet about a second time, the loom can be quiet too.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Quiet is the size of it. She has said the end. I will not ask her to say it better.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Fifteen, and two pies, and a lodging in Aldermanbury. I can keep that in the kitchen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will carry the water, Alse, and not the play. The hat is for church. It is not for a story on the south porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The porch can have the hat. The verdict stays in this room.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The close is cold. That is all the news I have of the street. A playhouse is not a thing I am taking across it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat, if you are eating. The loaf is on the board. I have not put it to the notch, and I am not putting it there this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it, Mistress. I am not asking for the notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not ask whether the nurse was a boy. You have already said even she. That was the question I had saved.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is the one you will have. Church is at nine. Bands. The good cloak. No play in the aisle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit where the house sits. I am not carrying her sentence into the pew.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have the door when you want it. I am not coming to hear a man improve on a play he did not see.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the door can stay a door. Come, Alse. The pin is for church, and the play is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard you. I will not ask it again.
